clause: The normative render settings record - enumeration
spec_anchor_status: RESOLVED: derived from the assembled Master Spec module, not provisional

scope.summary: The normative render settings record.** 104 controls recovered; the 18 that carry a value are reproduced with their complete option lists, because a render setting whose members are unknown cannot be implemented. *Derivation: enumeration table, taken whole; yields 1 microtask whose acceptance criteria are its members.* | Setting | Members | |---|---| | `quality` | `current_settings`, `best`, `draft`, `wireframe` | | `resolution` | `current_settings`, `full`, `half`, `third`, `quarter`, `custom` (custom takes an explicit divisor pair) | | `disk_cache` | `current_settings`, `read_only` | | `proxy_use` | `current_settings`, `use_all_proxies`, `use_comp_proxies_only`, `use_no_proxies` | | `effects` | `current_settings`, `all_on`, `all_off` | | `solo_switches` | `current_settings`, `all_off` | | `guide_layers` | `current_settings`, `all_off` | | `color_depth` | `current_settings`, `8_bits_per_channel`, `16_bits_per_channel`, `32_bits_per_channel` | | `frame_blending` | `current_settings`, `on_for_checked_layers`, `off_for_all_layers` | | `field_render` | `off`, `upper_field_first`, `lower_field_first` | | `pulldown_3_2` | `off`, `WSSWW`, `SSWWW`, `SWWWS`, `WWWSS`, `WWSSW` (the five phase choices; each letter is a whole or split frame) | | `motion_blur` | `current_settings`, `on_for_checked_layers`, `off_for_all_layers` | | `time_span` | `length_of_comp`, `work_area_only`, `custom` | [...]
scope.spec_text_is_authority: The clause text above is quoted from the Master Spec. Where this contract and the spec differ, the spec wins and this contract is regenerated.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The enumeration accepts the member `quality` with the exact meaning the spec states: `current_settings`, `best`, `draft`, `wireframe`. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `resolution` with the exact meaning the spec states: `current_settings`, `full`, `half`, `third`, `quarter`, `custom` (custom takes an explicit divisor pair). No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.
The enumeration accepts the member `disk_cache` with the exact meaning the spec states: `current_settings`, `read_only`. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `proxy_use` with the exact meaning the spec states: `current_settings`, `use_all_proxies`, `use_comp_proxies_only`, `use_no_proxies`. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.
The enumeration accepts the member `effects` with the exact meaning the spec states: `current_settings`, `all_on`, `all_off`. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.
The enumeration accepts the member `solo_switches` with the exact meaning the spec states: `current_settings`, `all_off`. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.
The enumeration accepts the member `guide_layers` with the exact meaning the spec states: `current_settings`, `all_off`. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `color_depth` with the exact meaning the spec states: `current_settings`, `8_bits_per_channel`, `16_bits_per_channel`, `32_bits_per_channel`. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `frame_blending` with the exact meaning the spec states: `current_settings`, `on_for_checked_layers`, `off_for_all_layers`. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `field_render` with the exact meaning the spec states: `off`, `upper_field_first`, `lower_field_first`. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `pulldown_3_2` with the exact meaning the spec states: `off`, `WSSWW`, `SSWWW`, `SWWWS`, `WWWSS`, `WWSSW` (the five phase choices; each letter is a whole or split frame). No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `motion_blur` with the exact meaning the spec states: `current_settings`, `on_for_checked_layers`, `off_for_all_layers`. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.
The enumeration accepts the member `time_span` with the exact meaning the spec states: `length_of_comp`, `work_area_only`, `custom`. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `frame_rate` with the exact meaning the spec states: `use_comps_frame_rate` or an explicit rate, `hard_min` 0.1, `hard_max` 999. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence or table row in the cited spec clause. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication and fails the contract.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
For a parameter row, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown rather than mirrored from its opposite.
